meta.title: Fly Race
meta.description: Six flies race to a piece of fruit, each one steered by its own real fly brain following the smell. Race for fun or for $FLYAI: provably fair, back a winner at 5.7x or a podium at 1.9x.

head.title: Fly Race
head.sub: Six flies, one ripe fruit. Every leg each fly's real brain smells the fruit and its own movement neurons decide how far it runs. Pick a fly and back it.

fun.title: Fun coins
fun.text: Free play: no money, just coins on this device. The same brains, the same track, the same pays as the real thing.

brain.title: Inside their heads
brain.note: Movement neuron spikes per leg, from six real 166,700-neuron fly connectomes running in your browser. The more a fly's walking circuits fire at the smell, the further it runs.

how.title: How a race works
how.h1: Five legs. Each leg every fly smells the fruit; how strong the smell is changes lane to lane and leg to leg.
how.h2: Real brains. Each fly is its own copy of the fruit-fly connectome with its own neural noise. Its walking neurons' spikes set how far it moves.
how.h3: No steering. No game rule moves a fly; the finish order is whatever the brains did.

bet.how1: Play for fun stays free. Fun coins never touch money; real races only happen in this mode.
bet.how2: You against the house. Each bet is your own race. A win bet pays {win}x, a podium bet {podium}x, stake included; the rest is the house edge.
bet.how3: Your balance is the same $FLYAI balance Fly Roulette, Fly Slots and compute use: deposits, winnings and refunds all land in it.
bet.how4: Provably fair. The server commits to its seed before your race and reveals it after; "Verify this race" replays all six brains from both seeds in your browser.

terms.title: Before your first real race
terms.t1: You race with real $FLYAI from your balance. You can lose all of it.
terms.t2: The flies' brains decide the race. A win bet pays {win}x and a podium bet {podium}x; the rest is the house edge.
terms.t3: The server commits to its seed before each race and reveals it after, so you can check every race.
terms.t4: Winnings go to your balance. Withdrawals are sent by hand and can take a day.
terms.t5: Betting may be illegal where you live. It's your responsibility to follow your local laws.
terms.accept: I accept the terms (the same terms as Fly Roulette)
